name: RS Series Lead Free Hot Air Reflow Oven

items: Independent air velocity controlling by section can achieve flexible processing adjustment, dealing with various & complicated lead-free processing easily
New cooling configuration to make the filtered or reclaimed air return to the oven chamber, reducing thermal loss and improving flux reclamation
Longer maintenance period for the oven chamber
New air management system with significant energy savings, lower electric power consumption, and lower carbon emissions
The chambers with multi-layers and thicker thermal insulation to attain a lower temperature of the oven surface
95% of the materials of the reflow oven can be recycled
